listing.blurb: Sculptural fluorescent tubes illuminate a receding gallery corner with vibrant chromatic washes, igniting tube by tube through architectural configurations.
listing.prompt: Fluorescent light in the manner of Dan Flavin: plain coloured tubes arranged in a corner and along a wall, their light flooding the white surfaces with coloured washes that overlap and mix, the arrangement rebuilding tube by tube. Make it striking on a big projected wall in a dark room: a bold composition, rich colour against real blacks, depth, glow, and motion that reads from across the room. Keep a demoscener's economy: lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, low-resolution offscreen buffers for any per-pixel work, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
